summary: SPIR-V printf heap corruption. A captured repeated-run set reproduced STATUS_HEAP_CORRUPTION (0xC0000374) in 33/40 v1.6.2104 runs and 28/40 v1.6.2106 runs; v1.5.2010 and v1.6.2112 were each clean in 30/30, and later release probes were clean through v1.9.2607. The v1.9.2607 release binary and current main Debug were each clean in 55/55 runs across ps_6_0 and cs_6_0, with expected SPIR-V inspected on main. The reported retail-heap stack detects the bad free during front-end parsing, before legalization, but does not identify the original write. The original -fcgl -Vd flags avoided a separate SPIRV-Tools crash fixed by PR #4280; all four flag combinations repeatedly reproduce on both affected releases, so the flags do not suppress this crash. Application Verifier/page heap was not rerun.
title: [SPIR-V] crash compiling shader using printf
